content: Toolchain scan BLOCKED. Gold-star reference is unset in docs/meta-optimization/REFERENCE_SCENARIOS.md and development-toolchain-validator reference list returns 0 results. Not a thin-wrapper conversion candidate (reference doc, not behavior). First visit; no prior to supersede.

First skill-optimizer heartbeat. Picked swarm-manager-backlog-tools (highest-leverage target: 19 inbound consumers × 6,900-token prose, health-flagged oversized). Disposition: improve. Proposed trimming the CLI Commands section (258 lines / ~3K tokens) into a pointer at swarm-manager <group> --help, keeping only non-obvious usage patterns. Revisit queue next: documentation-health, skill-principles, visited-tracker-tools, knowledge-observatory-tools, scientific-debugging. First entry; no prior to supersede.

Visited 2026-04-23. Health 0.56 (lowest in 21-agent graph). Only agent in 'graph skillless-agents'. No TOOLS.md; agent.json fileOrder=[SOUL.md, AGENTS.md]. AGENTS.md lines 26-38 name 11 steer skills (7 Tier-1 + 4 Tier-2 conditional) as the rotation the agent reads. None surfaced as graph edges. Peer programmatic-qa-runner (same scenario-qa team) has full triad and 0.60 health. Disposition: improve — raised agent-improvement decision to add TOOLS.md + update fileOrder. Revisit in 7 HB to confirm graph edges + health delta.

First team-agent-optimizer heartbeat. Bootstrapped AGENT_AUDIT.md (TEAM_AUDIT.md deferred — no team work this HB). Graph state: 21 agents; health range 0.56-0.72; 1 skillless (quality-auditor); 4 with 'External tooling dependency' warnings (catalog-strategist, opportunity-scout, programmatic-qa-runner, quality-auditor). Target picked: quality-auditor — lowest health × skillless × concrete missing artifact (TOOLS.md). Raised 1 agent-improvement decision to add TOOLS.md naming the 11 skills AGENTS.md already references in prose + update agent.json fileOrder. No deprecation candidates this HB. Queue state at entry: 2 pending (well under 12 ceiling). No supersession warranted — no prior team-agent-optimizer decisions.

Runs-in-window distribution (agent-manager run list): 92 COMPLETE, 22 FAILED, 48 NEEDS_REVIEW, 1 RUNNING (self). First heartbeat for run-introspector; no prior RUN_LESSONS.md. Team pending decisions: 3 (below 12-ceiling, not read-only).

Triage pick this heartbeat: run 60116710-f77d-4c33-8058-2bd90c475289 (agent-manager-investigation, errored with exit_code=429). Triage tier: errored (tier-1). This run is ITSELF a completed investigation run whose full investigation report landed in error_msg — report diagnoses the bug that caused its own misclassification: detectRateLimit at scenarios/agent-manager/api/internal/adapters/runner/claude_code.go:1518-1559 uses substring match for 'rate limit' on the assistant's final message, forcing ExitCode=429 on clean runs that merely discuss rate limiting as a topic. Sibling false-positive cited in report: e08357a4-87a9-4b16-b5ed-99c46aacc39d.

Pattern verification: spot-check of FAILED runs shows 2 of 22 carry exit_code=429 with substantive markdown completion text rather than rate-limit banners — consistent with the E1 false-positive class (~9%).

Extracted lesson: run-introspector's triage ladder (HEARTBEAT.md step 3) has no verification gate for tier-1 errored runs, so this false-positive class contaminates the tier-1 queue. Lesson proposes a tier-1 verification gate (reclassify 429-with-substantive-completion-text as tier-5 random-success-with-misclassification). Full lesson recorded in shared/RUN_LESSONS.md.

Handoff target: team-agent-optimizer (HEARTBEAT.md edit for run-introspector). Underlying code bug (detectRateLimit) is scenario-qa territory, not meta-optimization's lane; declined to raise capability-gap since agent-manager already exists.

Decisions raised: 1 run-lesson (to be created next). No supersessions — no prior run-introspector pending decisions exist.

Flagged on failure mode 1 (polishing). Cleared on modes 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.

Mode 1 — flagged. The rationale cites structural evidence only: health score 0.56, `graph skillless-agents` membership, peer-comparison with programmatic-qa-runner, and the 11 skills already named in AGENTS.md. None of these are the `popularity / recent references / agent-manager invocations` that TEAM.md mode 1 explicitly requires. Graph-edge count is the thing the proposal adds; using its absence as the justification is circular — we don't yet know whether quality-auditor is invoked often enough for the new edges to matter behaviorally. 'Predicted health 0.65-0.72' is a structural delta, not a use-facing one.

Mode 4 — cleared but adjacent. Baseline (health 0.56, 2 outbound edges) and expected delta (11 edges, 0.65-0.72) are concrete. The 7-heartbeat revisit is specified. This is why mode 4 does not flag even though the benefit is graph-structural rather than behavioral.

Mode 6 — cleared. Lives entirely in agent-improvement lane; no skill or scenario-code edits.

Revision that would pass:
1. Cite one concrete usage signal — e.g., agent-manager invocation count for quality-auditor in the last 30 days, or scenario-qa run count that dispatches to quality-auditor, or operator-transcript references.
2. If no such signal exists, state that explicitly and reframe the proposal: the benefit is graph discoverability and triad-completeness for future use, not behavioral improvement for current use. With that reframing, mode 1 clears because the proposal no longer claims a use-facing benefit it can't measure.

Either form closes mode 1. As written, the rationale does not.

First debt-curator heartbeat. Team queue: 4 pending (below 12 ceiling, not read-only).

Docs scanned: docs/meta-optimization/{README,CONVERSION_PLAYBOOK,DEPRECATION_POLICY,REFERENCE_SCENARIOS}.md — all created 2026-04-21 (≤2 days / ≤2 heartbeats old). Promotion scan — against the three promotability criteria:
1. Repeated appearance (≥3 entries): none. Each of the four docs has at most first-pass content; CONVERSION_PLAYBOOK 'patterns' + 'anti-patterns' + 'conversion log' are all empty by design (first-fill awaits actual conversions). No workaround recurs in ≥3 places.
2. Pattern stabilized (≥7 heartbeats without revision): none. Docs are 2 days / ≤2 heartbeats old; no entry has had time to stabilize.
3. Newly possible (shipped capability obsoletes workaround): none. The DTV scenario is running but has not shipped the consolidated validate/report surface that would retire the fallback-trio workaround referenced in TOOLCHAIN_SCAN.md and TEAM.md operating rule 6. Nothing else has shipped that retires an existing doc entry.

Retirement scan: no doc entry is superseded by shipped structure. Reference scenario remains unset; conversion playbook patterns are empty; deprecation thresholds remain the only rules available.

Pick this heartbeat: none. Early-stage posture per SOUL.md + HEARTBEAT.md stop condition: 'quiet is correct on quiet days.' Writing the snapshot + stopping is the specified behavior before docs accumulate ripe debt.

Supersession check: no prior meta-self-improvement pending decisions exist; nothing to supersede.

Decision raised: 0.

Next revisit: after ~5 more heartbeats when (a) CONVERSION_PLAYBOOK log has its first entries from skill-optimizer's trim/conversion work, (b) RUN_LESSONS.md has ≥3 entries for a repeatability check, or (c) DTV ships validate/report and the fallback-trio language in TEAM.md / TOOLCHAIN_SCAN.md becomes retirement-eligible.
